features.name: AI consumption billing for Business Central
features.description: A new billing mechanism for copilot features in Business Central that uses Microsoft Copilot Studio messages as a common currency across Microsoft products and services, with options for prepaid message packs or pay-as-you-go plans.
caveats: Currently only the sales order agent is built for AI consumption billing
Requires linking Business Central environment to Power Platform environment

features.name: Copilot and Agents capabilities page
features.description: Rebranded page formerly called 'copilot and AI capabilities' that lists all copilot capabilities and agents, with notifications about AI activation and capacity usage.

features.name: Preview evaluation capacity
features.description: Limited preview capacity provided to every Business Central tenant to allow customers to set up and try the sales order agent before committing to paid billing options.
caveats: Runs out after initial trial period

features.name: Prepaid Copilot Studio message packs
features.description: Monthly subscription option for purchasing a fixed number of Microsoft Copilot Studio messages upfront, renewable every month.

features.name: Pay-as-you-go billing plan
features.description: Flexible billing option where customers pay for the number of Copilot Studio messages consumed after the month concludes, without pre-purchasing capacity.

features.name: Generative answers meter
features.description: Billing meter that measures the number of messages generated by AI features, specifically counting each email message generated by the sales order agent.

features.name: Autonomous actions meter
features.description: Billing meter that measures operations performed by agents, including actions on sales quotes and sales orders.

features.name: Power Platform billing inheritance
features.description: Business Central environments can link to Power Platform environments to automatically inherit billing policies and capacity settings configured at the Power Platform level.
caveats: Requires linking to Power Platform environment
Must be same environment type and geography

features.name: Per-environment capacity allocation
features.description: Administrators can allocate specific message capacity limits to individual Business Central environments and optionally disable overages to maintain predictable costs.
